youtube.description:
Ndedi uses a chatbot to summarize driver messages and asks about last month's data. Tanyi explains how large language models work, from tokenization to prediction.

Chapters
0:00 Hook
0:19 Listening
0:35 Understand: what happens when you ask
1:09 Decide: training versus context
1:36 Build
2:02 Constraint and fix
2:31 User test
2:50 Where this applies
3:00 Ownership

Fictional teaching scenario. Wouri Express and its people are invented; the setting draws on documented conditions in Douala, Cameroon.
Complex AI. Explained visually. Built practically.
